data.description:
Restore author attribution on knot notes and handoff capsules. Since 2026-08-26 every note and capsule is recorded as '[unknown <date>]' instead of the writing persona, INCLUDING writes made under a lease that kno itself bound during claim. Attribution worked the day before under the same workflow, so this is a regression (kno 0.17.6), not the documented lease-identity behaviour.

Evidence (measured 2026-08-26, kno 0.17.6, quilt store):
- quilt-94a1: 4 notes + 2 capsules dated 08-26 ALL '[unknown]'; 3 notes dated 08-25 are '[claude]'. Leases 5909/7b51/6933 were bound via successful 'kno claim --e2e ... --lease'.
- quilt-b726: 3 notes + 6 capsules dated 08-26 ALL '[unknown]'; 08-25 writes attributed. Two independent sessions, same day boundary.
- Lease enforcement is still live: 'kno update 94a1 --lease 2f08' after shipped was REJECTED ('lease binding is only allowed during claim operations'). Binding works; author RESOLUTION from the bound lease does not.

Why it matters: a review note that cannot name its reviewer is not an audit trail, and because leaseless and lease-bound writes render identically as '[unknown]', an unattributed write is indistinguishable from an unattributable one — the documented leaseless behaviour becomes an alibi hiding the regression.

Out of scope: the git-note rail (refs/notes/sneka-agents) — separate mechanism, working.

History: originally filed as quilt-f12d; that record was corrupted by register churn (came back as type=lease, title 'Lease: codex-knot-7bda-approved-shipment-claim' with this knot's body — the 08b5 shape) and is abandoned in place (lease_terminated). Recreated here 2026-08-26 at operator request. Related: aed7 (leaseless-note attribution gap), 08b5 (register churn).
